key_points: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reportedly resigns amid spy scandal; NVDA is ~6.1% of S&P 500, creating a meaningful index-level headwind
Nvidia leadership turmoil and upcoming earnings raise uncertainty for the largest SPY constituent and AI trade broadly
Mention of a hot inflation print adds macro rate risk to equity multiples
Most other headlines are routine ETF flow/positioning noise with negligible thesis impact
SPY itself saw large inflows ($4.25B), but flows are typically coincident/noise rather than predictive
